shortDescription: HBSE / BSEH Class 12 Compartment Result 2026 is out. Check marks with roll number at bseh.org.in.
content:
The Board of School Education Haryana (BSEH / HBSE) has declared the Class 12 Compartment / Supplementary Result 2026.

Students who appeared in the Senior Secondary compartment examination can check subject-wise results using roll number on the official board website.

How to check

  1. Visit bseh.org.in
  2. Open Class 12 Compartment Result 2026
  3. Enter roll number and required details
  4. Download / print the result

Collect the original marksheet through school as per board instructions.
